budget_C_roles.ready_means: Roles and workflow, not adopted numerical thresholds

qoi_classes.position_units: Absolute difference of nondimensional Z/L or X/L

direct_mapping_reason: L1 continuity norm does not specify output-specific sensitivity, defect location/sign/support, coupling or nonlinear remainder; extrema positions may be nonsmooth.

quota_A.name: Single relative quota with separate absolute-position quota
limitations: No independent basis for identical allowance across Nu and velocity outputs
Near-zero baseline needs an independent characteristic scale
Positions already need a separate rule

quota_B.name: QoI-specific quotas organized by physical class
limitations: More freedom requires independent rationale and preregistration
Identical values within a class require separate justification

quota_C.name: Same-QoI verification uncertainty hierarchy
quota_C.hierarchy_candidate: E_Q_cont_upper <= c_Q * U_Q_disc_in_matching_units, together with an independently justified b_Q cap
limitations: Valid independent U_Q_disc needed
Continuity-induced iterative error can overlap iterative uncertainty
Large discretization error must not automatically relax the quota
Artificial source response is not automatically a conventional iterative-error estimate
quota_C.recommended_role: Rationale and hierarchy audit, qualitative until applicability and factors are justified

quota_D.name: Absolute scientific-significance quota
quota_D.rule: Independent smallest effect that could change the scientific conclusion, specified in each QoI's units
advantages: Direct link to research purpose when an effect size exists
limitations: No scientific effect size supplied for this verification benchmark
Conclusion stability alone does not establish numerical agreement quality
quota_D.possible_future_role: Additional independent cap if a scientific requirement is provided

quota_architecture_ready_scope: QoI-specific formats, rationale fields, uncertainty hierarchy audit and staged confirmation workflow only
numerical_quota_missing_basis: Independent conservation allocation within the research accuracy requirement
Applicable same-QoI verification hierarchy and valid uncertainty estimates

sensitivity_experiment.grid_notation: n by n by 1 depth cell

physics.boundary: Four impermeable physical walls; empty front/back
physics.initial_state: Common U=0 and T=300.5 K; all remaining initial fields and gauge fixed in future manifest

hypotheses.H1: Does decreasing actual epsilon_phi_mean reduce each QoI impact? Monotonicity is tested, not assumed.
hypotheses.H2: Do matched-actual-mean location/patterns give different QoI impacts?
hypotheses.H3: Do concentrated local maxima reveal impacts that mean alone cannot predict?
hypotheses.H4: Are natural pressure-tolerance residual patterns and artificial controlled sources equivalent in response? No equivalence is assumed.

arm_1.purpose: Natural residual-pattern sensitivity and coupled-trajectory confounding assessment
arm_1.additional_numerical_stopping_cutoffs_st: Register before future runs; do not derive scientific quota from stopping settings

arm_2.purpose: Controlled zero-net discrete-continuity source response of the coupled solution
arm_2.recommended_coupling: Modified continuity RHS maintained at every SIMPLE iteration in a separate future verification-only solver

coupling_alternatives.frozen_field_one_shot: Operator diagnostics only; no coupled U/T/p response
coupling_alternatives.maintained_flux_override: Requires explicit projection timing and U/phi consistency; less clean attribution
coupling_alternatives.modified_continuity_RHS: Recommended with source units/sign, pressure reference and zero-source control verified
coupling_alternatives.manufactured_source: Secondary code/operator verification; additional equation sources change interpretation

arm_2.physical_defect_relation: q=g+r_forced, with reference handling and roundoff audited
arm_2.source_units: g_i in m^3/s; g_i/V_i in s^-1
arm_2.source_construction: g=B_h*a using internal faces only; normalize after overlap/cancellation
arm_2.position_registration: Nondimensional anchors, deterministic face/cell and tie rules; physical-support and mesh-scaled families separated
arm_2.boundary_layer_registration: Selection rule based on zero-source independent baseline, frozen before impact data
arm_2.amplitude_range_status: UNRESOLVED; independent capability pilot, multiple decades, no formal epsilon input
arm_2.within_run_source_amplitude: Fixed using Up_base; no Up_run feedback

same_mean_matching.match_target: Actual steady epsilon_phi_mean using Up_run and measured q
same_mean_matching.procedure: Preregistered between-run amplitude bracketing/adjustment, with full reconvergence and no assumed monotonicity
same_mean_matching.tolerance_status: UNRESOLVED; based on measurement uncertainty before response comparison
same_mean_matching.failure_rule: Unmatched or nonmonotonic cases remain inconclusive for same-mean hypotheses

arm_2.zero_source_control: Verify stock equivalence before nonzero sources
arm_2.temperature_caveat: Original div(phi,T) responds to T*div(phi) at nonzero q; absolute T/TRef fixed; no silent theta replacement or compensating heat source
arm_2.interpretation: Response to a deliberately perturbed discrete continuity equation, not an accepted solution of the original source-free physical problem

arm_3_optional.purpose: Independent detection of wall leakage even when global net is zero
arm_3_optional.nonzero_net_caveat: Incompatible with original closed steady incompressible source-free cavity; no requirement to converge that impossible problem
arm_3_optional.future_coupled_extension: Requires an explicitly consistent source/open/transient problem with separate scope

sensitivity_experiment.baseline_definition: Per-grid zero-source independent microcase with tightest tested pressure tolerance, sufficiently steady coupled fields and QoIs; highest-fidelity tested numerical baseline, never truth
sensitivity_experiment.uncertainty_rule: Paired interval/envelope; conservative combination without unsupported RSS or duplicate accounting
sensitivity_experiment.effect_not_resolved_rule: Observed difference no larger than baseline uncertainty, or more strictly paired difference uncertainty, is not resolved; not zero impact or quota PASS

response_metrics.scale_rule: Preregister selection and near-zero rule before impact analysis; freeze per-grid baseline scale; no arbitrary denominator floor
response_metrics.raw_interval: [max(0,D_Q-u_Delta),D_Q+u_Delta] with scale uncertainty propagated where needed
response_metrics.extrema_ambiguity: Peak sets/intervals and extraction uncertainty, not arbitrary tie-break sensitivity
response_metrics.unresolved_points: Intervals/censored observations; no artificial positive floor for log slopes

threshold_inference_rule: After independently justified preregistered b_Q, require impact upper envelope including uncertainty <= b_Q for every required QoI/pattern/sign/state/grid with convergence, boundary compatibility and local investigation resolved. Choose only a contiguous zero-side supported region, never an isolated high-epsilon PASS. Finite tested levels do not establish an interval without justified interpolation/bounds, nor guarantee untested patterns. Separate exploratory calibration from quota justification and holdout confirmation.
applicability_scope: Ra_test=30000, Pr=0.71, specified closed cavity, 20/40/80 mesh family, v6 registered operators, serial DP ASCII16, tested steady branch and residual/source patterns only

user_decisions.A_architecture: Whether to use HYBRID B+C as the next-stage quota architecture
user_decisions.B_numerical_value: Independent allowable QoI impact remains unresolved; scientific rationale cannot be supplied by response alone
user_decisions.C_experiment_scope: Whether to execute the independent 30000/20-40-80 sensitivity experiment first as quota-calibration evidence, with Arm 1 plus verification-only Arm 2 and separate optional Arm 3
